title: Barbell Glute Bridge
summary: A hip thrust done with your back on the floor, with a shorter range but quick to set up.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for glutes (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly glutes total.
Library rating 0.3 for hamstrings (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly hamstrings total.
Library rating 0.3 for adductors (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly adductors total.

setup.text: Lie on the floor with a padded bar across your hips and your knees bent.
Drive through your heels to raise your hips until they're in line with your body.

form_cues.cue: Squeeze the glutes at the top
Tuck your chin and keep your ribs down.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds two or three ramp-up sets at rising loads before the first working set, unless that load is very light.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 6-10 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Set safety arms or pins where a missed rep can be set down, or use a spotter, and use collars.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.
